wine-spectator.name: Wine Spectator, Southern Rhône vintage chart
wine-spectator.note: Region-wide score and a short note. Excerpts only.

claims.claim: The winter before was dry and cool. Spring was dry and mild: only 50 mm of rain fell from March to May, against a normal 150 mm.
claims.note: Both give the same 50 mm and 150 mm figures, which may share a source.

claims.claim: Summer was hot and dry. It rained only twice, in late June and mid-August, for 30 to 70 mm depending on the parcel. Temperatures ran above normal from budbreak to harvest, a year the syndicate compares to 2003.
claims.note: One source. Wine Spectator agrees on a ripe, powerful year.

claims.claim: Storms around 15 August brought relief and hail in a few sectors. The mistral wind afterward kept the grapes healthy.
claims.note: One source. Hail zones were not named.

claims.claim: Harvest ran over more than two months. Some whites came in on 17 August and the first Syrah on 23 August.
claims.note: One source. Very early compared with 2019 and 2020 (Syrah in early September in 2020).

claims.claim: Yields were low. The syndicate says low yields. European Cellars says meaningfully down on a normal year. No figure was found.
claims.note: Both agree. No percentage or hl total read.

claims.claim: Growers picked parcel by parcel to hold down alcohol and aim for fine tannins. Each parcel expressed itself differently.
The reds lean riper and more red-fruited than jammy, with good acidity. Wine Spectator calls it ripe and powerful, with some gorgeous wines.
claims.quote: lean riper and more red-fruited than jammy
claims.note: Two sources, written early. Style may vary by parcel.

claims.claim: Wine Spectator scores the Southern Rhône 95 for 2022, the highest of 2018 to 2022. Its drink window is drink or hold.
claims.note: A region-wide score from one critic. The syndicate calls the year one of resilience and precocity, with high quality.

claims.claim: No source describes the 2022 whites. The only fact is that they were picked early, from 17 August.
claims.note: Do not describe their taste from this file.

conflicts: Rain: the syndicate says it rained only twice in summer for 30 to 70 mm. It also says storms near 15 August brought hail. Relief for some, damage for others.
gaps: No description of the white wines.
No critic report beyond Wine Spectator's short note.
Vinous, Decanter and Wine Advocate 2022 reports not read.
Little on Southern Rhône outside Châteauneuf.

sheet.vintage: A dry winter and spring, then a hot, dry summer. The crop was small and picking started in August. The reds are ripe and powerful, with red fruit and good acidity.
sheet.vintage_white: Whites were picked early, from 17 August, in a hot, dry year.
